title: FarmHarvestObservation
description: Standardized schema for recording empirical farm-level crop harvest and yield observations for supervised machine learning training.

crop.description: Standardized crop name (e.g. Tomato, Rice/Paddy, Okra, Brinjal, Sugarcane, Maize)

variety.description: Specific cultivated cultivar or hybrid variety (e.g., PKM-1, Arka Vikas, Co-51, CO-86032, Bhendi No. 10)

location.description: Farm location district or sub-district (e.g., Coimbatore, Thanjavur, Madurai, Salem, Dindigul)

sowing_date.description: ISO format date of sowing or transplanting (YYYY-MM-DD)

soil_type.description: Farm soil classification (e.g. Red loam, Black soil/loam, Sandy loam, Clay/loam, Fertile loam, Well-drained loam)

irrigation.description: Irrigation technique / water availability (e.g., Borewell Drip Irrigation (Optimized), Canal / River Basin Flow, Flood / Basin Irrigation, Sprinkler System, Rainfed (Monsoon Dependent))

rainfall.description: Recorded cumulative rainfall during crop growth cycle in millimeters (mm)

temperature.description: Average ambient temperature during crop growth cycle in degrees Celsius (°C)

humidity.description: Average relative humidity during crop growth cycle in percentage (%)

farm_area.description: Cultivated farm plot area in hectares

historical_yield.description: Observed final yield produced from the farm plot in metric tonnes (or tonnes/hectare)

actual_first_harvest_date.description: ISO format date when the farmer performed the first marketable picking or primary harvest (YYYY-MM-DD)

actual_final_harvest_date.description: ISO format date when harvesting was concluded for the crop cycle (YYYY-MM-DD)
